description: Defines the QuicSimpleServerBackend interface and its nested RequestHandler class for handling backend responses in a QUIC server implementation.

classes.name: quic::QuicSimpleServerBackend
classes.description: Interface for backend response handling in a QUIC server.

classes.name: quic::QuicSimpleServerBackend::RequestHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling individual backend requests and responses.

methods.name: InitializeBackend
methods.description: Initializes backend connection or cache with a given URL.

methods.name: IsBackendInitialized
methods.description: Checks if backend is ready for requests.

methods.name: SetSocketFactory
methods.description: Sets the socket factory used by the backend.

methods.name: FetchResponseFromBackend
methods.description: Triggers fetching a response from the backend for a given request.

methods.name: HandleConnectHeaders
methods.description: Handles headers for CONNECT method requests.

methods.name: HandleConnectData
methods.description: Handles data for CONNECT method requests.

methods.name: CloseBackendResponseStream
methods.description: Clears or closes the backend response stream.

methods.name: ProcessWebTransportRequest
methods.description: Processes WebTransport requests and returns a response.

methods.name: SupportsExtendedConnect
methods.description: Indicates if extended CONNECT is supported.
